text: WTI trades at $80.42 and Brent at $85.87. U.S. naval restrictions remain in place, Iran conditions full Hormuz reopening on their removal, and competing positions persist over shipping access and routes through the strait.

meta.note: Price movement and maritime access coexist; the entry centers the unresolved access structure.

text: The Strategic Petroleum Reserve holds 298.7 million barrels, its lowest level since January 1983, after a 6.1 million-barrel weekly decline. More than one-quarter of inventory was unavailable for drawdown as of December 2025 amid construction and cavern outages.

meta.note: Reported total inventory and operationally available inventory are distinct measures.
